airspace.zh: 辛格韋德利國家公園允許個人使用無人機，但須遵守冰島運輸管理局（Samgöngustofa）的一般規定；在北起雷拉爾服務中心、南到辛格瓦德拉湖的核心區（含阿爾曼納峽谷、法律石、斧頭河瀑布、教堂與絲浮拉），只能在早上9點前或下午6點後飛行。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Þingvellir National Park allows personal drone flying under the general rules of Iceland's Transport Authority (Samgöngustofa); in the core area from the Leirar service centre to the lake (Almannagjá, Lögberg, Öxarárfoss, the church and Silfra) flights are allowed only before 09:00 or after 18:00. Check the current rules before any real flight.

centre.zh: 辛格韋德利國家公園中心

title.zh-Hant: 世界最古老的議會之一

tagline.zh-Hant: 930年成立的議會、1000年的信仰抉擇，與1944年的共和國
tagline.en: An assembly founded in 930, a choice of faith in 1000, and a republic in 1944

zh: 西元930年，冰島人在這裡成立全國議會「阿爾庭」。
每年夏天，各地的人來到這片原野開會。
en: In 930 the Icelanders founded their national assembly, the Althing, here.
Every summer people came from all over the island to meet on these plains.

zh: 法律石是議會的中心，人們在這裡發表演說。
議會選出的「宣法人」任期三年，負責主持會議。
en: The Law Rock was the focus of the assembly, a natural platform for speeches.
The lawspeaker, elected for three years, presided over the meeting.

zh: 宣法人要在法律石上，背誦全國的法律。
在還沒有成文法典的時代，法律靠記憶流傳。
en: The lawspeaker recited the law of the land from the Law Rock.
Before written codes, law lived in memory.

zh: 宣法人三年任期內，每年背誦三分之一的法律。
三年下來，全國的法律就被完整念過一遍。
en: Over a three-year term the lawspeaker recited a third of the law each year,
so that in three years the whole law was heard.

zh: 阿爾曼納峽谷的岩壁，像一道天然的屏障與音響牆。
議會就在峽谷邊的原野上舉行。
en: The wall of Almannagjá made a natural backdrop and sounding board,
and the assembly met on the plain beside it.

zh: 約在西元1000年，議會決定接受基督教。
這個決定，避免了一場內部的分裂。
en: Around the year 1000 the Althing chose to accept Christianity,
a decision that averted a split within the country.

zh: 這裡除了一座農莊和後來的兩座教堂，
並沒有其他永久的建築。
en: Apart from a farm and, later, two churches,
there were no permanent buildings here.

zh: 參加議會的人，住在臨時搭建的棚屋裡。
斧頭河的水，供應了聚會期間的需要。
en: Those attending lived in temporary booths,
and the Öxará supplied water while the assembly lasted.

zh: 議會在這裡一直開會到1798年。
之後才遷到雷克雅維克。
en: The Althing met here until 1798,
after which it moved to Reykjavík.

zh: 十九世紀中葉，議會在雷克雅維克恢復運作。
它一直延續到今天，是冰島的國會。
en: In the mid-19th century the Althing was revived in Reykjavík,
and it continues today as Iceland's parliament.

zh: 1930年，議會成立一千週年，這裡成為國家公園。
它是冰島第一座國家公園。
en: In 1930, the Althing's thousandth anniversary, Þingvellir became a national park,
Iceland's first.

zh: 1944年6月17日，冰島在這裡宣布成立共和國。
國家的重大時刻，總是回到辛格韋德利。
en: On 17 June 1944 the Republic of Iceland was proclaimed here.
The nation returns to Þingvellir for its great moments.

zh: 2004年，辛格韋德利列入世界遺產。
它以文化遺產的身分登錄，見證了一個民族的自治傳統。
en: In 2004 Þingvellir joined the World Heritage List
as a cultural site, a witness to a people's tradition of self-government.

zh: 在兩塊大陸裂開的地方，
冰島人建立了屬於自己的議會與國家。
en: Where two continents pull apart,
the Icelanders built their own assembly, and their own nation.

tagline.zh-Hant: 法律石、棚屋、宣法人，與冰島人心中的聖地
tagline.en: The Law Rock, the booths, the lawspeaker, and a place Icelanders hold dear

zh: 走進阿爾曼納峽谷，一邊是岩壁，一邊是開闊的原野。
這裡曾是冰島全國的聚會場。
en: Walk into Almannagjá: rock wall on one side, open plain on the other.
This was once the meeting place of all Iceland.

zh: 議會開會時，人們在法律石前聚集。
宣法人在這裡宣讀法律，也宣布判決。
en: During the assembly people gathered before the Law Rock,
where the lawspeaker proclaimed the law.

zh: 議會期間，原野上搭滿了臨時棚屋。
各地來的人在這裡交換消息、做買賣、尋找婚配。
en: While it lasted, the plain filled with temporary booths.
People traded news and goods here, and sometimes found spouses.

zh: 教堂與農莊，是原野上少數的建築。
今天的白色小教堂，仍是國家公園的地標。
en: The church and farm were among the few buildings on the plain.
Today's small church is still a landmark of the park.

zh: 冰島的國家大事，常選在這裡舉行。
1944年的建國，就在辛格韋德利宣布。
en: Iceland often marks its great events here;
the republic itself was proclaimed at Þingvellir in 1944.

zh: 國家公園成立於1930年，紀念議會的一千年。
這片原野，被視為冰島民族的起點。
en: The park was founded in 1930 to mark a thousand years of the Althing.
This plain is seen as the birthplace of the Icelandic nation.

zh: 絲浮拉裂縫，是世界知名的潛水地點。
潛水客在兩個板塊之間的清水裡漂浮。
en: The Silfra fissure is a world-famous dive site.
Divers float in clear water between two plates.

zh: 能見度約一百公尺，像是在空氣裡游泳。
這片水，在地下旅行了約三十年才到達這裡。
en: With visibility around 100 metres, it feels like swimming in air.
The water took some 30 years underground to arrive.

zh: 辛格瓦德拉湖畔，散布著度假小屋。
湖是冰島人休閒、釣魚的地方。
en: Summer houses dot the shores of Þingvallavatn.
The lake is a place for Icelanders to rest and fish.

zh: 斧頭河瀑布是遊客最常停留的地方之一。
水聲在斷層崖之間迴盪。
en: Öxarárfoss is one of the places visitors linger longest.
The sound of water echoes between the fault walls.

zh: 教堂旁的農舍，今天是冰島總理的夏季官邸。
國家的領導人，仍然回到這片原野。
en: The farmhouse by the church is now the Prime Minister's summer residence.
The nation's leaders still come back to this plain.

zh: 辛格韋德利與蓋錫爾間歇泉、黃金瀑布，合稱「黃金圈」。
它是冰島最熱門的旅遊路線之一。
en: With Geysir and Gullfoss, Þingvellir makes up the Golden Circle,
one of Iceland's most popular routes.

zh: 2004年，辛格韋德利以文化遺產列入世界遺產。
UNESCO肯定它作為議會發源地的意義。
en: In 2004 Þingvellir was inscribed as a cultural World Heritage site,
recognised by UNESCO as the cradle of the Althing.

zh: 法律在這裡被背誦、國家在這裡誕生，
辛格韋德利是冰島人心中的聖地。
en: Law was recited here and a nation was born here:
Þingvellir is the place Icelanders hold dearest.

title.en: A Lake Between Ice and Fire

tagline.zh-Hant: 冰河過濾的泉水、地熱，與北極紅點鮭
tagline.en: Glacier-filtered springs, geothermal heat, and Arctic charr

zh: 辛格瓦德拉湖是冰島最大的天然湖。
它的水，大部分來自地下湧出的泉水。
en: Þingvallavatn is the largest natural lake in Iceland,
fed mostly by springs welling up from underground.

zh: 泉水源頭是北方的朗格冰河。
融水在熔岩裡流動約三十年，被過濾得非常清澈。
en: The springs begin at the Langjökull glacier to the north.
Meltwater spends about 30 years in the lava and emerges crystal clear.

zh: 湖裡的北極紅點鮭，演化出好幾種不同的型態。
它們吃不同的食物，住在湖的不同深度。
en: The lake's Arctic charr have evolved into several distinct forms,
eating different food at different depths.

zh: 一座湖裡，就能看到物種如何分化。
科學家把這裡當作研究演化的天然實驗室。
en: In one lake you can watch a species diverge.
Scientists treat it as a natural laboratory of evolution.

zh: 西南方的亨吉德火山，地底熱能豐富。
溫泉與蒸氣，從地面不斷冒出。
en: South-west, the Hengill volcano holds abundant heat underground,
with hot springs and steam rising from the ground.

zh: 這裡的地熱電廠，為雷克雅維克供應熱水與電力。
冰島人把火山的熱，變成日常生活的一部分。
en: Its geothermal plants send hot water and electricity to Reykjavík.
Icelanders have made the volcano's heat part of daily life.

zh: 裂谷的岩壁上，長著苔蘚與矮小的植物。
冰島的植物要適應短暫的夏天與寒冷的冬天。
en: Moss and low plants cling to the walls of the rift.
Iceland's plants must cope with short summers and cold winters.

zh: 裂谷東側的山，是另一個板塊的邊緣。
整個谷底，約有五公里寬。
en: The mountains on the eastern side mark the edge of the other plate.
The whole valley floor is some 5 kilometres wide.

zh: 斯傑爾德布雷達的熔岩，鋪滿了谷地的北方。
熔岩上慢慢長出了苔原與低矮的樺樹林。
en: Lava from Skjaldbreiður blankets the north of the valley,
slowly colonised by moss heath and low birch woodland.

zh: 斧頭河的水，最後流入湖中。
河與湖，連接著這片裂谷裡的生命。
en: The Öxará finally flows into the lake,
linking life across the rift.

zh: 朗格冰河是冰島第二大冰河，位在湖的北方。
它把融水，透過地下慢慢送進湖裡。
en: Langjökull, Iceland's second-largest glacier, lies north of the lake,
sending its meltwater slowly underground into it.

zh: 熔岩上的苔蘚長得很慢。
一旦被踩壞，要很多年才能恢復，請走在步道上。
en: Moss on the lava grows very slowly.
Once trampled it takes years to recover, so keep to the paths.

zh: 從正上方看，裂縫一道道平行排列。
大地被拉開的方向，清楚地寫在地面上。
en: From straight above, the fissures run in parallel lines.
The direction the land is being pulled is written on the ground.

zh: 冰河的水、火山的熱、裂開的大地，
辛格韋德利的生命，生長在冰與火之間。
en: Water from the glacier, heat from the volcano, ground that splits apart:
life at Þingvellir grows between ice and fire.

tagline.zh-Hant: 北美與歐亞板塊之間的裂谷、裂縫中的泉水，與冰島最大的湖
tagline.en: A rift between two plates, spring water in the cracks, and Iceland's largest lake

zh: 冰島的辛格韋德利，位在一條裂谷裡。
這條裂谷，是大西洋中洋脊露出地面的一段。
en: Iceland's Þingvellir lies in a rift valley,
a stretch of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge exposed on land.

zh: 裂谷的一邊是北美板塊，另一邊是歐亞板塊。
兩塊板塊正在慢慢分開。
en: On one side is the North American plate; on the other, the Eurasian.
The two are slowly drawing apart.

zh: 西側的阿爾曼納峽谷，是這一帶最大的斷層。
它看起來像一道真正的峽谷。
en: On the west, Almannagjá is the largest fault in the area,
a veritable canyon.

zh: 斷層的西壁高聳，東側的地面則往下沉陷。
大地拉開時，中間的地塊就跟著下陷。
en: Its western wall stands high while the ground to the east has dropped.
As the land pulls apart, the block in between sinks.

zh: 斧頭河在這裡從斷層的崖頂落下，形成斧頭河瀑布。
河水沿著峽谷，流向辛格瓦德拉湖。
en: Here the Öxará river spills over the fault as the Öxarárfoss.
The water then runs along the rift to the lake.

zh: 湖的北端有一道裂縫，叫絲浮拉。
它最寬約十公尺，最深約六十公尺。
en: At the north end of the lake lies a fissure called Silfra,
up to 10 metres wide and 60 metres deep.

zh: 裂縫裡的水，來自朗格冰河。
融水滲進多孔的熔岩，在地下流動約三十年才湧出。
en: Its water comes from the Langjökull glacier.
Meltwater seeps into porous lava and travels underground for about 30 years.

zh: 經過熔岩過濾，水的能見度約有一百公尺。
絲浮拉的意思是「銀」，形容它的清澈。
en: Filtered by the lava, the water gives visibility of about 100 metres.
Silfra means silver, for its clarity.

zh: 這一帶約五公里寬，有大約一百道裂縫。
絲浮拉每年加寬約一到五公釐。
en: About a hundred fissures cross a zone some 5 kilometres wide here.
Silfra widens by roughly 1 to 5 millimetres a year.

zh: 辛格瓦德拉湖面積84平方公里，是冰島最大的天然湖。
平均深34公尺，最深114公尺。
en: Þingvallavatn covers 84 square kilometres, the largest natural lake in Iceland.
It averages 34 metres deep and reaches 114.

zh: 湖水從南端的索格河流出。
湖本身，就躺在下陷的裂谷裡。
en: The lake drains south through the river Sog.
It lies in the sunken floor of the rift itself.

zh: 湖的西南方是亨吉德火山。
它一帶的地熱，供應首都雷克雅維克的熱水與電力。
en: South-west of the lake rises the Hengill volcano,
whose geothermal heat supplies Reykjavík with hot water and power.

zh: 東北方的斯傑爾德布雷達，是一座盾狀火山。
「盾狀火山」這個名稱，就是從它而來。
en: To the north-east, Skjaldbreiður is a shield volcano;
the very term "shield volcano" comes from its name.

zh: 這一帶的熔岩，大約在九千年前流成。
之後，大地就一直被拉開、下陷。
en: The lava here poured out about 9,000 years ago.
Ever since, the ground has been pulled apart and has sunk.

zh: 兩塊大陸之間的裂谷、冰河水注滿的裂縫、一座大湖，
辛格韋德利是地球正在生長的地方。
en: A rift between continents, cracks filled with glacier water, a great lake:
Þingvellir is a place where the Earth is still growing.
